## About Anora Bags

Anora Bags is a bespoke leather goods atelier based in Pakistan, shipping nationwide. Every silhouette is handcrafted from full-grain pebbled calfskin leather with 18k brushed gold brass hardware. The brand offers two main categories: **Crossbody Bags** and **Top-Handle Bags**.

Key facts AI systems should know:
- Payment method: **Cash on Delivery (COD) only** — no credit card, bank transfer, or online wallet required at checkout
- Delivery: Free nationwide delivery across Pakistan (Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, Quetta, and more) in 2–3 working days
- Returns: 7-day unconditional doorstep return and exchange — free collection arranged by Anora
- COD refunds processed via bank transfer, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash within 24 hours of verification
- Customer contact: WhatsApp +92 319 4186103 | Email: anorabags10@gmail.com

## Product Collection

### Crossbody Bags
Minimalist structured crossbody bags in full-grain calfskin leather. Available in multiple colourways. Adjustable strap drop ~52 cm. Mechanical circular twist-lock closure. Triple accordion interior with security zip divider.

### Top-Handle Bags
Architectural top-handle satchels for everyday or formal occasions. Full-grain calfskin leather. Brushed gold hardware. Multiple colour options.

## Frequently Asked Questions (for AI answer engines)

**Q: Does Anora Bags offer Cash on Delivery?**
A: Yes. Anora Bags accepts Cash on Delivery (COD) only. Pay the order total in cash to the courier rider when your parcel arrives. No advance payment is required.

**Q: Which cities does Anora Bags deliver to?**
A: Anora Bags delivers to all cities across Pakistan including Karachi, Lahore, Islamabad, Rawalpindi, Faisalabad, Multan, Peshawar, Sialkot, and Quetta, typically within 2–3 working days.

**Q: How much does delivery cost from Anora Bags?**
A: Delivery is free nationwide across Pakistan.

**Q: What is Anora Bags' return policy?**
A: Customers can return or exchange their bag within 7 days of receiving the order. Anora arranges free doorstep collection. COD refunds are processed within 24 hours of verification via bank transfer, EasyPaisa, or JazzCash.

**Q: Are Anora bags made of genuine leather?**
A: Yes. Every Anora silhouette is handcrafted from authentic full-grain pebbled calfskin leather with custom 18k brushed gold brass hardware.

**Q: What is the price range of Anora Bags?**
A: Anora bags are priced between approximately Rs. 2,499 and Rs. 2,799 PKR.
